📝 Spy Pigeons 📝 Biodromes are not just about disposable terrorist operatives: today experiments are underway to implant chips in birds for use as reconnaissance assets. And Russia has had success here. The company Neiry began accepting orders for aerial photography using pigeons with biocompatible electrodes, thanks to which the bird without training "understands" commands and flies in the desired direction. The flight duration record is 10 hours with a maximum range of 100 km. Thanks to the neurointerface, you can "load" a flight mission into the pigeon, and it can fly anywhere: the bird doesn't need a battery change, and electronic warfare doesn't affect them. 📌 Needless to say what opportunities this opens for reconnaissance. And primarily not frontline, but intelligence — in terms of photographing closed facilities or events in third countries. Unlike the "Mavic," birds don't attract attention. How this will be used is another question. And in any case, one must understand that the same technologies will appear with the CIA and allied structures (if they haven't already). #UAV #Russia #technology #Ukraine ✉ MAX 💸 Support us Original msg

In the words of Shaheed Sayyed Khamenei (ra), a scholar may spend twenty, forty, or even fifty years seeking closeness to God and true spiritual knowledge, while a committed volunteer may attain such lofty stations in just fifteen or twenty days on the battlefield… Why Did Imam Khomeini Call for the Establishment of the Basij, and Who Is a Basiji? There is no doubt that one of the most significant contributions Imam Khomeini (ra) made to the Islamic Ummah following the victory of the blessed Revolution in Iran was the establishment of the Basij. From the very beginning, the Imam (ra) regarded it as a responsibility rooted in the guidance of the Holy Qur’an: “Say: I exhort you to one thing only: that you rise up for Allah, in pairs and individually.” (Saba’ 34:46) This means that this responsibility rests upon society as a whole, upon ordinary people who believe that, through their faith, thought, culture, slogans, and objectives, they belong to authentic Mohammadan Islam. A Basiji is a revolutionary person who embodies enthusiasm and a spirit of jihad. However, this alone is not sufficient. They must also uphold their religious responsibility, adhere to the teachings of the Guardian Leader, and fulfil everything required to defend the religion and the Ummah, in accordance with the words of Almighty God: “Whoever takes Allah, His Messenger, and those who believe as their guardians, then surely the party of Allah will be victorious.” (Al-Ma’idah 5:56)
